_why: A friend's Singapore list (screenshot, 23 Oct 2026). Every place on it gets the 'rec' tag; the ones the guide lacked are added here. Chef Kang's left out: closed 10 Oct 2024.
tag: Ya Kun Kaya Toast (Far East Square)

places.src: Friend's rec; Lemon8 and TikTok reviews (2025)
places.d: Takeaway matcha kiosk from the Kyō Kohee team. Two benches outside, so it's grab and go.
places.tip: Banana pudding or strawberry compote matcha latte, about S$9-10. Daily 9am-9pm (Apple Maps); check.

places.src: Friend's rec; Time Out Singapore; Eatbook
places.d: Singapore's best-known matcha and hojicha bar: lattes, soft serve and plated tea desserts.
places.tip: Daily 12-9.30pm (Time Out). Also at Takashimaya and Odeon Towers.

places.src: Friend's rec; Singapore's largest hawker centre
places.d: Over 200 stalls upstairs from the wet market. Big, unglamorous and the real thing, a street from the tourist end of Chinatown.
places.tip: Go hungry and roam; many stalls close by mid-afternoon.

places.d: Seafront hawker centre at the far end of East Coast Park: satay, BBQ seafood and a sea breeze.
places.tip: Pair it with the East Coast Park run or a cycle; best at dusk.

places.n: Hill Street Tai Hwa Pork Noodle
places.src: Friend's rec; Michelin star from 2016 (listed in the 2025 guide)
places.d: The Michelin-starred bak chor mee: vinegary minced pork noodles, cooked bowl by bowl.
places.tip: Queues can run 1-2 hours, so go early on a weekday. About 9.30am-9pm, closed 1st and 3rd Mondays (sources vary). No queue: the sister stall Tai Wah Pork Noodle in Chinatown.

places.addr: #04-01 The Heart (East Tower), Marina One, 5 Straits View, 018935
places.d: Polished modern Cantonese, moved from Bukit Pasoh to Marina One.
places.tip: Book about a week ahead (Michelin). Lunch 11.15am-2.30pm, dinner 5.30-9.30pm; Sunday lunch only.
places.vibe: Smart Cantonese dining room, business lunches

places.src: Friend's rec; Tatler Asia; Homejourney chilli crab ranking (2026)
places.d: Old-school seafood house that claims to have invented black pepper crab. Chilli crab is the order.
places.tip: Crab is priced by weight, about S$95-110/kg. Book by phone. Daily 11.30am-11pm (sources vary).
places.vibe: Big banquet seafood hall, tourists and families

places.addr: Jewel Changi Airport, 78 Airport Blvd, 819666 (flagship; 40-odd outlets across town)
places.d: The kueh and cake bakery. Pandan chiffon and kueh lapis are the classics.
places.tip: A whole pandan chiffon is about S$20. Buy one on the way to a flight, or at any city outlet.
